manualAudit.method: Compared parsed output against the raw dataset payload; verified dataset provenance via the Socrata catalog API.
checks: Access decision: Ecology's separ search UI is robots-disallowed for query URLs (/separ/*?*). The register is instead consumed from data.wa.gov dataset mmcb-z6jf — Socrata catalog reports provenance 'official', attribution 'Washington State Department of Ecology', updated same-day. Per-record separegisterlink still cites the official record page (cited, not fetched).
Register id 193986 / SEPA 202601471: proposal name, lead agency file number, issue date, DNS document type all match the payload; sourceUrl points at apps.ecology.wa.gov/separ Record.aspx.
County mapping THURSTON/PIERCE/LEWIS/KING → domain enum verified on all 407 rows; non-pilot counties are filtered in the query and skipped defensively in parse.
normalizedStage left 'unknown' — SEPA document type → stage/event derivation belongs to M2 resolution, and non-project actions (ordinances) must not be forced into project stages.
leadagencyissuedate can be future-dated (comment periods); checkpoint takes max seen, 14-day overlap re-covers.
